sourceSentences: Neeko winds up spiritual essence over 1.25 seconds and highlights an area around herself, which is visible to enemies unless she is disguised. If Neeko is in a disguise, it will break after 0.5 seconds into the duration.
After winding up, the cast time begins and Neeko leaps upward, knocking up nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds.
If the spiral hits at least one enemy, it grows in size and its speed and root duration is increased.

If the burst kills an enemy or hits a champion or large monster, the seed blooms after 0.75 seconds to burst again, dealing magic damage to enemies in the same area. This may occur up to 2 times per cast.
While disguised as a plant or ward, Neeko can be targeted by minions and affected by most effects that normally don't affect them.
Disguising as a non-champion interrupts the cast time of Noxian Guillotine if it is targeting Neeko.
While disguised as a unit not targetable by turrets (e.g. wards, traps), Neeko cannot be targeted by turrets until she damages a champion.

For combos, your basic go-to is the W into E and Q before attacking away. And your all-in is to start disguised into W and ult, followed with E into Q before attacking away.
Neeko's ultimate creates a large circle around herself, and if she's disguised, enemies won't see it for the first half a second.
And if it hits an enemy, it grows in size, increasing its speed and root duration.
